scope: Shared catalog, configured default mock-project legacy stamps, and packaged engine examples. kitchen excluded. No stamp execution, no .rab browsing, no app changes.

template_backed.note: Copies settings, PATHS, and README files through runProjectStamp, substitutes project/input values, and initializes project memory. Creates audit storage scaffolding rather than application source.
Reads template/tmpl.mjs. compile() builds field extraction, coercion, and validation statements and inserts them into the wrapper. Outputs <name>.mjs.
Loads phrase.json and fills a language record. Writes JSON data rather than application code.
Uses its own project tree for type=magic-box; other types delegate to <type>/stamp-new-project. The local template does not represent every branch.
Copies a tool skeleton and nested template/ folder, expands tmpl.mjs, and fills settings.json. The generated executor initially returns template-not-implemented.
Copies a tool skeleton and fills settings.json; expands tmpl.mjs unless inherit_executor=true removes it and uses a parent executor. The new local executor is initially a placeholder.
Copies template/grid.css to the selected CSS directory without overwriting an existing grid.css.
Fills tmpl.css with an atom name and caller-supplied declarations; writes <name>.css.
Reads tmpl.html and the parent grids.json catalog. Builds the section elements and construction-seat comments internally, then inserts them into the wrapper.
Copies the HTML project tree and fills project tokens through runProjectStamp.
Fills hook-name and initial-value tokens in tmpl.tsx through runReactHookStamp.
Fills the hook-name token in tmpl.tsx through runReactHookStamp; the effect and dependency seats remain for later work.
Fills the component name and default class in tmpl.tsx through runReactComponentStamp; .tsx or .txt output.
template/dashboard.json only specifies layout, nav component, and nav area. Page and nav code come from child stamps; grid application and insertion come from child editing tools.
Uses the component writer with tmpl.tsx, serializing validated link data and label into its placeholders. The component structure is in the template.
Fills page name and slug in tmpl.tsx, including an addressable page-root construction seat.
Copies the complete React/Vite/TypeScript source and configuration tree; fills project tokens and initializes project memory.
Fills tmpl.tsx through runReactComponentStamp under a supplied parent path; .tsx or .txt output.
